sloka: वैवस्वत महाबाहो न खल्वमितविक्रम ।न हन्तव्यस्त्वया तेन दण्डेनैव निशाचरः ।। ७.२२.३९ ॥
transliteration: vaivasvata mahābāho na khalvamitavikrama ।na hantavyastvayā tena daṇḍenaiva niśācaraḥ ।। 7.22.39 ॥

translations.english: When Yama was indeed desirous of striking Ravana with his mace, the grandfather Brahma directly appeared before Yama and spoke these words.
